feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
entry.summary: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

entry.title: House Democrat warns 13 Trump allies to save their records for upcoming investigations
entry.summary: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.

entry.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a grounded love story, a gonzo crime thriller and a gaming triumph
entry.summary: An inspired synthesis of violent satire and contemplative storytelling, Grand Theft Auto VI is more mature and ambitious than any prior game in the record-breaking franchise.

entry.title: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
entry.summary: Children frolic around the ever-watchful and calm Käthe Kollwitz cast in bronze, in a square named after the German artist, whose work often depicted children in the wake of World War I.

entry.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
entry.summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

entry.title: How the East Potomac golf course became a D.C. landmark — and what could happen to it
entry.summary: A federal judge is keeping East Potomac Park open for now, but hasn't ordered the government to keep the municipal golf course operational.

entry.title: Project Gryffindor: Meta's plan to get more school kids using Instagram
entry.summary: Meta said it launched its "school partnership program" to keep teens safe, but internal documents tell a different story.

entry.title: Special education teachers shared their stories. You told NPR you felt seen
entry.summary: NPR is following along as about a dozen special education teachers navigate this school year and share their joys and challenges. Listeners say they're not alone.

entry.title: OpenAI announces new AI safety program; researchers worry it won't be enough
entry.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he would grant "employee level" access to outside researchers to evaluate AI safety. The pilot program appears much more restrictive.

entry.title: China and the U.S. are still the biggest polluters, but only China is doing better
entry.summary: The two largest emitters of greenhouse gases are China and the United States. Now, the countries' stories are diverging: many Chinese provinces are reducing coal use, while the U.S. is falling behind on climate technologies.
